items.h: OpenAI Is Building a $500 per Month ChatGPT Pro Max Plan, Leaks Suggest
items.s: Leaked code strings and screenshots point to a new tier that would cost 25 times more than ChatGPT Plus, aimed at people who need the bot to work faster, not just longer.

items.h: Bitget clarifies $388M in assets affected by security breach
items.s: The Bitget breach announced on Thursday affected about $35 million more than previously reported, based on an analysis of assets on Zcash and TRON.
alt: North Korean Hackers Linked to $388M Bitget Crypto Exchange Theft: CEO

items.h: Bitget Hack Losses Climb to $387M: Here’s What Happened, and Why North Korea Is a Suspect
items.s: An attacker faked internal transfer requests to drain $387.5 million from Bitget's hot and warm wallets, and the exchange's CEO says the fingerprints look like Pyongyang's.

items.h: Bitget Raises Hack Estimate To $387.5 Million As Token Accounting Widens
items.s: XRP and ether dominate the identified outflows. Withdrawals remain paused as the exchange adds Zcash and TRON assets to its accounting.

items.h: Strategy seeks shareholder approval for daily preferred stock dividends
items.s: Strategy’s proposal would move STRC and its three other preferred stocks to daily dividend payments, following a similar move by Bitcoin treasury firm Strive.

items.h: Magic Eden Warns Old Ethereum NFT Listings Are Exposed to Payment Processor Exploit
items.s: A flaw in Limit Break's Payment Processor V2 put old Magic Eden Ethereum listings at risk, prompting a whitehat rescue of more than 23,000 NFTs.

items.h: Legacy Magic Eden Approvals Exploited as White Hats Rescue NFTs
items.s: Yuga Labs’ 0xQuit says 23,155 NFTs worth more than $5.7 million were secured. Holders still need to revoke the vulnerable contracts’ NFT and token approvals.
